description: This file defines an enumeration ('enum') for calendar locations, with two possible values: INTERNAL and EXTERNAL. It includes a method to get the opposite location.

classes.name: CalendarLocation
classes.description: An enum representing calendar location types with the ability to retrieve the opposite location.

methods.name: getOpposite
methods.description: Returns the opposite calendar location: if current is INTERNAL, returns EXTERNAL; if EXTERNAL, returns INTERNAL.
